_comment: Hand-authored decisions, style rules, and known cross-source conflicts for this workstream. Not generated — edit directly. 'status: open' conflicts need Ali to pick the correct value; update the source YAML/tex file and this entry together once resolved.

decisions.rule: Everywhere the Ph.D. grade is mentioned, write "(Distinction)" — never "summa cum laude".

Multiverse Computing start date is Nov 2025 internally (data/experience.yaml, cv/1pageCV.tex), but shown as Dec 2025 on LinkedIn specifically, per Ali's explicit instruction. This is a deliberate per-platform difference, not an error.

Never claim RLHF, DPO, PPO, or GRPO for the Multiverse post-training work. Describe it as knowledge distillation (SubDistill, top-K logit distillation) and quantization-aware healing/recovery training.

No internal/private numbers, client names, or unreleased-research details in any public-facing text (website, CV, LinkedIn). Only the publicly reusable metrics already in data/*.yaml and cv/1pageCV.tex are safe to reuse.
Nothing in drafts/linkedin.md (or any future LinkedIn text) gets posted to LinkedIn without Ali's explicit review and approval. Draft only.

Position Ali broadly: Senior LLM Researcher who leads model evaluation, builds AI tooling, and works on LLM post-training and efficient models, with a strong research record — not narrowed to a single one-line pitch.

Recruiter/opportunity data, draft outbound replies, and anything from cv/1pageCV.tex's companion private package marked 'not cleared for public use' must never be committed to this public repo. They live only in a private, non-repo location (see that store's own README for where).
